title: Every event needs an OSA event proposal
statement: Every club or society event needs the OSA Event Proposal form, at least 2 weeks before the event, not counting weekends and holidays. Book the Student Activities Outlook calendar for the date by sending a calendar invitation.

requirements.name: OSA event proposal + calendar invitation to Student Activities

sources.quote: Finalized Expense form + Student Activity/Poster Display Request ... >= 2 weeks before the event, excluding weekends/holidays
Please book the studentactivities@aub.edu.lb Outlook calendar by sending a calendar invitation

title: The adviser approves every proposal
statement: The club's adviser must approve the proposal; the form sends it to the adviser's AUB e-mail.

requirements.name: Adviser approves the proposal

sources.quote: Adviser's AUB Email ... otherwise your form won't be submitted correctly to your adviser

title: Anything the club pays for goes on the expense form
statement: All expenses need OSA approval before any commitment: fill the expense form and upload it with the proposal. Items given by sponsors are not listed on it. Buying something also needs a proposal.

requirements.name: Expense form uploaded with the proposal

sources.quote: All revenues/expenses (monetary or not) need OSA approval before any commitment.

sources.locator: stated by the Running Club president
sources.quote: sponsors are not included on the expense form

title: Receipts within 1 week after the event
statement: Receipts and invoices go to Student Activities within 1 week after the event; after 4 weeks they are rejected.

requirements.name: Receipts and invoices within 1 week after the event

sources.quote: Receipts/invoices within 1 week after the event; after 4 weeks automatically rejected.

title: Spending over $200 needs a members' vote
statement: Expenses over $200 need a majority vote of the members, recorded in minutes and submitted with the proposal.

requirements.name: Minutes of the members' majority vote

sources.quote: Expenses over $200 need a majority vote of members, recorded in minutes, submitted with the proposal.

title: Major events need 6 weeks
statement: Major events (conferences, gala dinners, rally paper, or a budget over $1,000) are submitted at least 6 weeks before.

requirements.name: Submit the proposal 6 weeks before (major event)

sources.quote: Major events (conferences, gala dinners, rally paper, or budget > $1,000): >= 6 weeks before.

title: Sponsors need a sponsorship document
statement: Each sponsor needs a document stating the type of sponsorship (money, goods, discount, vouchers, service) and what the sponsor gets; money also states timing and method.

requirements.name: Sponsorship document (type + what the sponsor gets)

sources.quote: Sponsor documents state the sponsorship type (money, goods, discount, vouchers, service) and the return (e.g. logo)

title: No energy-drink, alcohol, tobacco or bar sponsors
statement: Sponsors may not be related to energy drinks, alcohol, cigarettes or bars.

requirements.name: Check no sponsor is an energy drink, alcohol, cigarette or bar brand

sources.quote: No sponsors related to energy drinks, alcohol, cigarettes or bars.

title: Prizes: winners e-mailed, no cash
statement: Prizes go on the expense form; after the event, e-mail the winners' names, IDs, contacts and amounts. No cash handling.

requirements.name: E-mail winners' names, IDs and amounts; prizes on the expense form

sources.quote: Prizes: email with winners' names, IDs, contacts, amounts; no cash handling; prizes in the Expense form.

title: Posters and flyers need the OSA stamp
statement: Posters need OSA approval and a stamp before posting (official boards only, max A3, 75 per event); flyer distribution needs approval in advance. Sponsor logos max 3 x 3 cm.

requirements.name: OSA approval and stamp for posters and flyers

sources.quote: OSA approval + stamp before posting; submitted to West Hall 112.

title: No AUB logo without Communications approval
statement: AUB's logo or branding may not be used without prior approval from the Office of Communications. Logos of non-AUB entities are not put on club material.

requirements.name: No AUB logo without Communications approval; no non-AUB logos

sources.quote: AUB's logo or other branding elements may NOT be used in digital communication without prior approval from the Office of Communications.

sources.locator: stated by the Running Club president
sources.quote: Non-AUB entities may not have a logo on club material.

title: Mass e-mail may not promote events
statement: Mass e-mail may not promote events or send reminders; use the events website, newsletter, campus screens or social media.

requirements.name: Promote through the events site, screens or social media

sources.quote: Mass email may NOT promote events (no reminders either).

title: Hostler facilities are requested 2 weeks ahead
statement: Hostler / CHSC facilities (Green Field, track, pool, courts) are requested at least 2 weeks ahead; clubs come last in priority and may be bumped; one supervisor per 20 participants.

requirements.name: Hostler / CHSC facility request

sources.quote: Exclusive use: request >= 2 weeks ahead through the director of university sports

title: Rooms are reserved through WebReserve
statement: Rooms for an event are reserved through AUB WebReserve (West Hall auditoriums A, B, C, Bathish, room 310).

requirements.name: Reserve the room on WebReserve

sources.quote: For facility reservation, please refer to the following link: webreserve
Click here to reserve any room

title: Non-AUB guests need approval and a list of names
statement: Guests from outside AUB need approval; attach an Excel list of their names to the proposal.

requirements.name: Approval for non-AUB guests + Excel list of names

sources.quote: Non-AUB community guests require approval.
For non-AUB guests, please provide a list of their names in an excel file

title: Tickets and fees: list of participants and payments
statement: Ticketed events, trips and tournaments need an Excel of participants with tracking numbers and the amount each paid.

requirements.name: Excel of participants, tracking numbers and amounts paid

sources.quote: Ticketed events / trips / tournaments: Excel of participants, tracking numbers, amount paid each.

title: Partner clubs: state the split
statement: Events with other student organizations or departments state how expenses and revenues are split.

requirements.name: Expense and revenue split with the partner

sources.quote: Collaboration with other student orgs/departments: state the expense/revenue split.

title: External organizations: overview and split
statement: Events with an NGO or other non-AUB organization include an overview of it, its role and the expense split. External NGOs generally may not use clubs for fundraising.

requirements.name: Overview of the external organization, its role and the split

sources.quote: Collaboration with NGOs / non-AUB entities: overview of the entity, its role, the expense split.

title: Speakers: details and CV, free of charge
statement: Public speakers need first name, last name, nationality, subject and a brief CV; speakers and performers must be free of charge.

requirements.name: Speaker names, nationality, subject and CV

sources.quote: please provide the following (First Name, Last Name, Nationality), the subject of their talk and attach a brief CV
Speakers/performers must be free of charge.

title: Food and drinks: list items and suppliers
statement: Events with food or drinks list the items and suppliers, using the procurement set menus; OSA sets a food ceiling per event type.

requirements.name: List of food items and suppliers (procurement set menus)

sources.quote: please provide the list of items and the corresponding suppliers
Food ceiling set by OSA per event type.

title: Risky activities need an EHSRM safety recommendation
statement: Some activities (water, big crowds, roads, physical risk) need a safety recommendation signed by an EHSRM safety officer.

requirements.name: EHSRM safety recommendation

sources.quote: Some activities need an EHSRM (safety) recommendation.

title: Official filming needs Communications approval
statement: Official filming or photography on AUB premises to promote an event needs Office of Communications authorization and consent of identifiable people.

requirements.name: Communications authorization for filming + consent forms

sources.quote: Official filming/photography on AUB premises to promote AUB programs or events ... needs Office of Communications authorization

title: USFC money: no catering, prizes or salaries
statement: USFC funding needs the event approved first and cannot pay for catering, prizes or salaries; it must be disclosed in publicity.

requirements.name: USFC money cannot pay for catering, prizes or salaries

sources.quote: Event must be AUB-approved first; no catering, no prizes, no salaries

title: Fundraisers prove payment to the beneficiary
statement: Fundraisers include proof of payment to the beneficiary in the impact report.

requirements.name: Proof of payment to the beneficiary (in the impact report)

sources.quote: funds raised, proof of payment to beneficiary (fundraisers)

title: Impact report after every event
statement: After every event, fill the Post-Event Impact Report (attendees, impact, lessons learned, photos).

requirements.name: Post-Event Impact Report after the event

sources.quote: Impact: attendees, impact on club, goal achieved, LESSONS LEARNED
